articles.title: Asian shares are mixed and oil prices hold steady as the US raises pressure on Iran
articles.description: Asian shares are mostly lower after U.S. stocks drifted to a mixed finish ahead of potentially market-moving events later in the week. Regional benchmarks traded in a narrow range and U.S. futures were nearly unchanged. Oil prices were little changed after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced fresh sanctions against Iran and warned that countries persisting in doing business with the Islamic Republic would face retaliation. On Monday, the S&P 500 slipped 0.3% and the Dow industrials added 0.3%. The Nasdaq composite fell 0.8%. Bond yields eased. Investors are awaiting a profit report from Nvidia on Wednesday and a speech by the Federal Reserve’s new chairman, Kevin Warsh, on Friday.
